evidence.text: A left hand; compare 又
Pictograph of a left hand. The 工 (work) component was added later to represent the meaning "help; assist", now written as 佐.
手相左助也。从𠂇、工。凡左之屬皆从左。

Originally written 𠂇 and 䶹 in the oracle bone script: Pictogram (象形) – a left hand. Compare 又 (“right hand”).
Late bronze inscription forms show an added 工 (“work; to assist?”) component, making the current form a phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *ʔsaːlʔ, *ʔsaːls) and ideogrammic compound (會意 /会意): phonetic 𠂇 (“left hand”) + semantic 工 (“work”), representing the original form of 佐 (OC *ʔsaːls, “to assist”).
Cognate with 佐 (OC *ʔsaːls, “to assist”) (< be on one's left side); mirror of the semantic relationship between 右 (OC *ɢʷɯʔ, “right”) and 佑 (OC *ɢʷɯs, “to assist”) (Schuessler, 2007).
Unrelated to Proto-Tibeto-Burman *b(w)aj (“left (hand)”) (STEDT).

evidence.source: 中央研究院漢字古今字資料庫（Academia Sinica Character Database）
evidence.text: 資料庫列出左的甲骨文、金文、楚系簡帛、小篆及《說文》字形，並說《說文》古文左象人的左手。它列有一筆金文著錄「集成04313」。這支持左手象形說及字形跨階段的比較；網頁沒有給甲骨文實物的具體年代或逐件釋讀，故不能據此指定最早用例年代。
evidence.title: 漢字「左」：字形演變

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫（香港中文大學人文電算研究中心）
evidence.text: 資料庫稱早期字形作𠂇，象左手；後期金文在其上加工而成左。它說甲骨文、金文中的左用作方位詞「左」，金文又用左表輔助、作佐的初文，並舉虢季子白盤「是用左（佐）王」及晉公盆「左（佐）右（佑）武王」。這與把工說成「後加的助義部件」相符，但資料庫沒有提出聲符分析，也沒有給這些銘文的具體年代。
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：左

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫（香港中文大學人文電算研究中心）
evidence.text: 所錄《說文》文本為「左，手相左助也。从𠂇、工」，並標「則箇切」；又列《廣韻》上聲「臧可」及去聲「則箇」兩切。這是傳世字書的解釋與反切資料，並非早期圖形自身已表音或證明借字的證據。
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：左

evidence.source: ShuoWen.org 所載《說文解字》及段玉裁注
evidence.text: 《說文》解作「手相左助也。从𠂇、工」。宋代徐鉉等注「今俗別作佐」。段玉裁認為《說文》此處的左是後世佐字義，而𠂇才是今左字；他又把工解作左助之意。這是清代對許慎說解的校注，不能當成已證實的甲骨文字形史。
evidence.title: 說文解字「左」

evidence.field: A01151 研訂瀏覽／形體資料表
evidence.text: 條目將𢀡等列為左的異體，轉錄碑刻資料，並指出一碑形「蓋左之訛」。這表明傳抄、碑刻中存在訛形；沒有證據把此訛形當成左的構形祖形。該條目所列甲骨文字集釋、金文編等部分原始字形資料在頁面上標為未提供。
evidence.title: A01151 左（教育部《異體字字典》2024）

evidence.source: Baxter–Sagart 2014 表格（本地資料列；外部讀音頁僅作可讀的點擊參考）
evidence.text: 本地表中左有三列：現代拼音 zuǒ、MC tsaX、OC *tsˤa[j]ʔ（gloss “left (side)”）；同一 MC 與 OC 另有 “assist” 列；另有 MC tsaH、OC *tsˤarʔ-s 的 “assist” 列。這些是 Baxter–Sagart 2014 的不同列與重建，不能把三列合併成單一讀音。它們只記載左本身；沒有給𠂇的獨立行，故不能單憑這組資料證成𠂇為左中的聲符。
evidence.title: 左（存檔 Wiktionary 頁，列出 Baxter–Sagart 資料）

evidence.text: 本地 Unihan kMandarin 行為左 zuǒ。指定官方單字查詢頁本次無法由瀏覽工具載入，故本地行可確認讀值，但未能驗證官方頁的實際內容；此現代讀音不證明古代構形或聲符關係。
evidence.title: Unihan Database Lookup：U+5DE6（本次無法存取）

evidence.text: 已檢索左的甲骨、金文構形及早期義項、說文分析、Baxter–Sagart 讀音、Unicode Unihan 頁面與《左傳》用例。中研院字形庫、ShuoWen.org、教育部異體字典及中大多功能字庫已開啟核對；Unihan 指定頁無法存取，ctext 字典頁與《左傳》頁回覆 403。沒有將搜尋摘要當作已核實內容。
evidence.title: 外部研究存取紀錄

evidence.text: The record presents oracle-bone, bronze, Chu bamboo/silk, small-seal, and Shuowen forms for 左 and states that an ancient form of 左 depicts a person's left hand. It identifies a bronze inscription entry as 集成04313, but gives no archaeological date or individually dated oracle-bone example on this page.
evidence.title: 漢字「左」：字形演變

evidence.source: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Multi-function Chinese Character Database
evidence.field: 形義源流通解; 左 row
evidence.text: The database describes an early graph written 𠂇, interpreted as a left hand, and later bronze forms with 工 added. It reports oracle-bone and bronze usage for the direction ‘left’; it also reports bronze 左 for assisting, as an early form of 佐, citing 虢季子白盤 and 晉公盆. The entry gives no dates for those inscription examples, so it supports reported uses but not their precise chronology or a complete semantic pathway.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：漢字甲骨部件分析（手部，左 row）

evidence.source: Shuowen.org, transmitted Shuowen text and Duan commentary
evidence.text: The page transmits Xu Shen’s analysis, 「左，手相左助也。从𠂇、工」. The page also records Xu Xuan’s note that the separate form 佐 is used in common writing and Duan Yucai’s interpretation that 左 in this Shuowen entry has the later 佐 sense, while 𠂇 corresponds to the later directional 左. This is historical lexicographic interpretation, not direct proof of the graph’s earliest formation.
evidence.title: 說文解字「左」

evidence.text: The supplied local dataset has distinct rows for 左: modern pinyin zuǒ, Middle Chinese tsaX, Old Chinese *tsˤa[j]ʔ (‘left (side)’); the same MC and OC notation also occurs on a separate ‘assist’ row; another ‘assist’ row gives MC tsaH and OC *tsˤarʔ-s. These are separate dataset entries. No row for 𠂇 was supplied or verified, so these host readings do not establish 𠂇 as a phonetic component.
evidence.title: 左（存檔 Wiktionary 頁；secondary click-through for Baxter–Sagart data）

evidence.source: Unicode Unihan, official lookup interface; local reading row also supplied
evidence.text: The supplied local Unihan row gives 左 kMandarin zuǒ. The official Unicode lookup documentation confirms that its interface exposes Unihan readings and other properties, but the requested direct record URL https://www.unicode.org/cgi-bin/GetUnihanData.pl?codepoint=5DE6 could not be opened in this run. Thus the local value is recorded as local data, not as a verified reading on the direct official record page. Modern metadata does not establish an ancient sound relationship.
evidence.title: Unihan Database Lookup: U+5DE6 (direct record inaccessible in this run)

evidence.text: The official Unihan lookup documentation says the interface provides per-ideograph property data including meaning and reading information, and points to the Unihan data files and UAX #38. The page itself did not expose the specific U+5DE6 result in this run.
evidence.title: Unihan Database Lookup

evidence.text: The character page links to an institutional intellectual-property notice, but the notice was not successfully opened during this run. The site’s character page itself states All Rights Reserved; it is therefore used as linked evidence and not proposed as an image asset.

editorial_rules: Write about the character's graphic history; distinguish it from the history of a spoken word.
Separate historical explanation from mnemonics. Do not infer history from modern shapes or readings.
Sources may repeat one another. A source count is not independent corroboration.
Treat Shuowen as a historical account, not automatic confirmation. Its generated English glosses are excluded.
Unrelated word senses may appear in Wiktionary excerpts. Do not merge them into a character origin.
Related-character evidence retains its record_character. Do not silently transfer a traditional form's components to a simplified form.
No glyph image has been visually inspected in this packet. Do not claim to have inspected one.
Explain missing evidence explicitly, especially for Japanese-created characters. A Chinese spelling pronunciation is not evidence for a Japanese origin.

gaps: 目前可核來源將早期字形釋為左手，並報告甲骨文已有方位義；未取得帶考古年代、甲骨片編號及可檢視字形的個別原始辭例，故最早實物見例年代未建立。

工在構形中的作用存在分析差異：《說文》把左解為手相左助，字庫敘述是原𠂇上加工；提供的來源不足以把後加部件進一步判定為純義符或兼有聲符作用。沒有獨立𠂇讀音的本地 Baxter–Sagart 行，不能用 host 左的讀音冒充部件讀音。

Unihan 官方 U+5DE6 單字查詢頁存取失敗；本地 sources/unihan/Unihan_Readings.txt 行可提供左的 kMandarin 值 zuǒ，但無法依本次規則附上已檢視成功的官方記錄。
本次沒有建立𠂇作為聲符的獨立讀音或歷史音系比較；左的 Baxter–Sagart 多列讀音只屬 host 資料。可支持的表述限於𠂇是字庫所述左的早期圖形構件，不能把聲符角色當定論。
未推薦建立本地外部資料擷取檔：本次只需引用字詞特定條目，且未核實重複來源材料的授權條款、版本化範圍及可重現匯出許可。

Neither checked page establishes whether 工 is solely semantic or also phonetic. No independent reading for component 𠂇 was verified, so no phonetic-role conclusion is made.
The local Baxter–Sagart data checked here contain 左 readings only. Exact independent local rows for 𠂇 were not supplied; no phonetic comparison can be reported for that component.

The exact Commons pages for the two local glyph leads could not be verified. No actual direct image URL, exact-page provenance, or reuse license was established, so no glyph is proposed. The Xiaoxuetang specific form and rights notice were likewise not verified.
